context.body: Disclosure becomes a sustained exchange about judgment and justice.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: The LORD chooses to disclose the outcry against Sodom and allows Abraham’s repeated appeal concerning the righteous and wicked.
observations.label: God discloses judgment to Abraham: action

observations.body: Abraham approaches, asks about justice, and presses the number down to ten.
observations.label: God discloses judgment to Abraham: response

observations.body: Shall I hide? · Judge of all the earth · righteous · wicked
observations.label: Words in Genesis 18:16–33

payload.posture: Read Genesis 18:16–33 as promise and the patriarchs evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The dialogue stops at ten and does not narrate why Abraham stops there.
payload.title: God discloses judgment to Abraham
